title: Advantech ADAM-6050 18-Channel Isolated Digital I/O Module
description: Baseline model for the Advantech ADAM-6050 18-channel isolated digital I/O module (12 digital inputs, 6 digital outputs) read over Modbus TCP. Register map: ADAM-6000 User Manual Ed. 12, Appendix B.2 'ADAM-6000 I/O Modbus Mapping Tables', ADAM-6050 tables, PDF pages 214-218 (printed pages 204-208); function codes in section 7.3.2, PDF pages 106-108. The 0X and 4X reference numbers are converted to zero-based addresses (00001 is address 0, 40001 is address 0), which the register tables imply. BLOCKING CONFLICT to settle on hardware: the manual's own example frames (section 7.3.2, PDF pages 107-108) use the reference number as the start address on the wire (coils 00001-00008 read with start address 0x0001, analog inputs 40001-40002 with start address 0x0001), which would be one higher than this model; the model follows the register tables. Digital inputs 00001-00012 are read as discrete inputs (function code 02, example on PDF page 107) and digital outputs 00017-00022 as coils (function code 01, same page). The 32-bit counters read the low word first: the manual gives counter = (value of 40002) x 65536 + (value of 40001) (remark 1, PDF page 218), so these points set the word order to low first. They are valid only for a channel configured as a counter. In frequency mode the low word holds the frequency in units of 0.1 Hz and the points are not meaningful. Left out: the counter start, clear, overflow and latch bits and the pulse settings, which are configuration or control; the all-channel DI and DO words (40301, 40303), whose bit layout the manual does not state; the diagnostic words and the GCL flag and counters; and the module name words, whose value for this module is not documented.
